name: Ramocsaháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ramocsaháza (a blue and green shield with a yellow bird, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name RAMOCSAHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ramocsaháza arms with helm, crest and mantling
